messages:
maya_cs: FYI customer AcmeCorp just escalated — their production rerank results diverged after last night's model rollout. They say identical queries now get very different scores.

maya_cs: Example from support convo: they POST to /v1/re-rank with model=redwood-rerank-v3 (rolled out 03:10 UTC). Responses used to rank doc A > B, now B > A. They attached raw responses.

ana_support: Can you paste the request + responses here? Need exact payload, headers, and response arrays.

maya_cs: Pasting sanitized snippet they sent (redacted keys):
```json
POST /v1/rerank
{
  "model": "redwood-rerank-v3",
  "query": "How do I reset my api key?",
  "documents": ["Reset via console > settings", "Contact support to rotate keys"],
  "return_scores": true
}
```

maya_cs: Old scores (before v3): [0.87, 0.42]
maya_cs: New scores (after v3): [0.41, 0.89]

ben_ml: That's a big inversion. First triage: are they hitting deterministic scoring (model uses logits -> softmax) or sampling? Rerankers should be deterministic.

ben_ml: Also check that the request parameters are identical (temperature, top_k, any normalize flags). If v3 changed internal score normalization that could flip magnitudes.

ana_support: I asked them to confirm headers and query params — they confirmed no temp/top_p set. Only model param changed from redwood-rerank-v2 -> v3.

ben_ml: v3 did include a different scoring head and a new normalization step (we rolled that out for better calibrated confidences). That can change absolute scores but shouldn't flip ranking often. We need to reproduce.

ben_ml: @deploy-bot can you show the rollout changelog for redwood-rerank-v3?

deploy-bot: Release redwood-rerank-v3 deployed 2025-11-28T03:08:21Z. Changes: scoring head v2->v3, softmax temperature adjustment, fixed tokenization mismatch for some punctuation. Canary at 10% -> 100% at 03:10Z.

eric_infra: Also confirm they pinned model name. If they used model alias that auto-redirects to new variants, they might be getting a variant with a different tokenization.

maya_cs: They explicitly set model=redwood-rerank-v3 in the body.

ben_ml: OK. Next steps I'm going to run the customer's exact inputs through our offline eval harness on both v2 and v3 with deterministic settings (seeded argmax). I suspect the tokenization fix changed token boundaries causing context differences.

ben_ml: Quick repro I ran: same query+docs on v2 -> scores [0.86,0.43]; v3 -> [0.40,0.88]. So reproduced locally against model snapshots.

dina_product: Does the new scoring head change ranking semantics intentionally? Product decision should have considered reranker stability.

ben_ml: v3 aimed at better calibration / probability interpretation, not ranking, but normalization can change pairwise comparisons when logits are close. Edge cases where docs are semantically similar can flip.

ana_support: Customer wants either rollback or a mitigation (pin to v2) while we investigate. They are on production Dedicated and this affects UX.

ben_ml: Short-term: advise customer to pin model to redwood-rerank-v2. I'll check whether v2 snapshots are still available in their region and whether pinning is possible without config churn.

eric_infra: We can pin them; need to ensure tokens and routing handle it. I'll open a config ticket to enable immediate pin on their tenant and do a cautious canary rollback if they want.

maya_cs: Customer asked for root-cause and whether this is a bug or expected drift. They want an internal report with reproducible steps and diff of tokenization + logits.

ben_ml: I'll produce an evaluation report: seed, model snapshots, exact tokenization (token ids), raw logits, softmax temperatures, and a small autop-run across their top 500 queries to measure % flips.

ben_ml: Preliminary numbers: on 500 seed queries from their bundle, 4.6% of top-1 rankings flipped v2->v3; mean score delta magnitude 0.32. Not trivial.

dina_product: 4.6% is significant. For rerankers we should have a stability gate in the rollout process (e.g., run customer evals or threshold on expected flip rate).

ben_ml: Agree. For now: action items - (1) Offer customer temporary pin to v2 (maya/ana to coordinate ops ticket). (2) Ben will deliver reproducible report + tokenization diffs by EOD. (3) Product to add rollback/stability checklist for future reranker rollouts.

ana_support: Maya — I'll draft the customer response: apologize, offer pin or rollback, explain calibration intent but acknowledge impact, and promise a technical report within X hours.

maya_cs: Sending to customer now with both options. They'll opt to pin to v2 for 24h while we investigate.

ben_ml: For the internal report I'll include code to reproduce:
```python
# snippet to reproduce pairwise scores
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=\"REDACTED\")
input_payload = {\"model\":\"redwood-rerank-v3\",\"query\":\"How do I reset my api key?\",\"documents\":[\"Reset via console > settings\", \"Contact support to rotate keys\"],\"return_scores\":True}
resp = client.rerank(input_payload)
print(resp['scores'])
```

ben_ml: Also including tokenization sample: v2 tokens: [101, 345, 78,...] -> v3 tokens: [101, 345, 79,...] with difference at punctuation. That changed context window alignment and produced different logits.

eric_infra: I'll handle the pin config for AcmeCorp and log the tenant-level override. ETA 15 minutes.

maya_cs: Thanks. Keep this thread updated. Please upload Ben's report and token diffs to the incident doc when ready.

ben_ml: Will do. Adding note: long-term fix options: (A) revert tokenization change for reranker-only model variant, (B) add a post-score ranking-stability rescorer that penalizes deviation from previous model (customer-configurable), or (C) require stability gate in rollout pipeline.

dina_product: We'll discuss stability gate in next PM sync. For now move fast on customer pin + full repro package.

maya_cs: Closing loop — AcmeCorp confirmed pin to v2 and UX restored. They asked for timeline for permanent fix. I'll escalate to PM.

ben_ml: Report uploaded to /docs/incidents/1751254821-rerank-regression-report.md (internal). Will attach final diffs there.

maya_cs: Thanks team :raised_hands:
